title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding steady at $75,946, off just 0.3% over 24 hours—consolidation mode persists. Fear & Greed sitting at 26, firmly in fear territory, but that's actually healthy at these levels. Stops holding.

**On-chain picture looks solid.** Hashrate climbed to 933.9 exahashes—miners aren't panicking despite the pullback. Mempool's clean with 85k transactions, fees compressed at 6 sat/vB. No congestion signals.
